demos.name: Secrets Vault LAB
demos.description: A per-user credential vault (strictly self-service, no administrator override, real AES-256-GCM, injected at request time by a simulated gateway so the backend logs who actually acted, merge-edit, staged delete purged after 24 hours, 500 entries and 64 KB bounds) and secret store management over five mock providers (AWS, GCP, Azure, Delinea, CyberArk: separate read and write grants, audit, nightly re-sync, metadata only with the value fetched live and never stored): a simulation of the 2026-11-02 Ping release claims. Mock tables, or a Live local engine with a lab clock you move. Every product claim is UNVERIFIED on our tenant.
demos.notes: Host-run: ./scripts/run.sh (port 7450). Docker: HOST_PORT=7450 docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1 only). Mock and Live are both loopback-only with zero outbound calls; every credential is a lab-labelled mock and no API ever returns a stored value.
